attempts|case: Thorne is named in Case 0017 and the earlier recovery history. His involvement is documented; his motives are not.
family|tablet: The tablet claims to remember Javis while his family records change. Whether the two events are causally linked remains unknown.
photo|revisions: The revisions describe another Javis; the photograph appears to show a matching figure. The image alone cannot establish identity.
family|spindle: The spindle and altered family records both concern Elara. The reason for the changes is not established by these records alone.
tablet|watch: The watch stopped at 02:14, matching the termination time recorded in Case 0017. The significance of that match remains unresolved.
brass_wheel|tablet: The wheel's change coincides with a Codex exchange reading. The exact mechanism cannot be confirmed from these two records alone.
family|notebook: The notebook's handwriting resembles writing associated with Elara. Its provenance remains uncertain.
nightingale|watch: Nightingale measures exchange effects; the stopped watch may be relevant, but it has not been independently identified as an exchange signature.
annex_shipment|demolition: A shipment record names a site the demolition record says no longer exists. The records conflict; neither establishes what happened on site.
reed_report|reed_statement: Reed's official report differs from his private statement. The discrepancy requires explanation; his statement remains subject to his consent.
cas_shipment|reconciliation_request: HR-017 cites the Cassius Vale shipment. The relationship between the authorization and correction process warrants examination.
admission_register|plate: The admission register and brass plate both distinguish two subjects. Their identifiers correspond.
admission_register|cassius_letter: Cassius's letter predates the second registration and alludes to two children. It does not establish what he knew with certainty.
cassius_recording|plate: The recording depicts two children; the plate records one retained and one transferred. The records are consistent on that limited point.
attempts|correction_logs: Correction logs record removals followed by unregistered returns. The repeated pattern raises questions about whether the underlying condition was resolved.
exchange_indicator|tablet: The exchange indicator responds in the presence of both Javis and Aren. The readings alone do not identify the cause.
portable_unit|station_nine_archive: The portable unit and Station Nine archive contain complementary reference data. Their combined use still requires validation.
case|iteration: CASE 0017 and ITERATION 017 use conflicting status descriptions. The available fields do not establish why.
